instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run tool:see-what-work-is-ready-to-publish", and give it graph.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:see-what-work-is-ready-to-publish and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: The answer's $.selectedRecord.blockers[0].message contains "Add proof first.".
